4#include "COINAlgebra/Core/DecayVector.h"
5#include "COINAlgebra/Algebra/CAlgebra.h"
6class PathAlgebra;
7
8// Isotropic, identical-detector model of paper Section II.B, Eqs. (28)-(32).
9// Efficiencies are whole-array probabilities CONDITIONAL on gamma emission.
10// Total efficiency includes full-energy and partial-energy (Compton) events.
11// Maps are copied, keyed by transition name; 0 <= peak <= total <= 1.
12// An empty conversion map means no IC. Otherwise every used edge needs alpha.
13class DetectionMaps
14{
15public:
16    using EfficiencyMap = std::unordered_map<std::string, double>;
17    DetectionMaps(const EfficiencyMap& peakEfficiencies,
18                  const EfficiencyMap& totalEfficiencies,
19                  std::size_t detectorCount,
20                  const EfficiencyMap& conversionCoefficients = {});
21
22    std::size_t DetectorCount() const;
23    // Each map preserves stationary terms, and applies the product of its
24    // edge factors to longer paths. Input coefficients must contain IC-inclusive
25    // physical branches, not already gamma-emission-weighted branches.
26    DecayVector FullEnergyHit(const DecayVector& vector) const; // q * peak
27    DecayVector TotalHit(const DecayVector& vector) const;     // q * total / N
28    DecayVector SummingOut(const DecayVector& vector) const;   // 1 - q * total / N
29
30    // Avoid all of m distinct detectors: product_e (1 - m*q_e*total_e/N).
31    // Useful for resolved coincidences where every selected detector must stay
32    // free of unobserved deposits. Requires m <= N; m=0 is the identity.
33    DecayVector AvoidDetectors(const DecayVector& vector, std::size_t m) const;
34
35    // Diagonal maps on observed coincidence factors only. They preserve
36    // stationary markers and do NOT change the connection weights of a fiber.
37    // Mapping the base decay and constructing a new CAlgebra is a separate step.
38    CAlgebra::Vector FullEnergyHit(const CAlgebra::Vector& vector) const;
39    CAlgebra::Vector TotalHit(const CAlgebra::Vector& vector) const;
40    CAlgebra::Vector SummingOut(const CAlgebra::Vector& vector) const;
41
42    // Eq. (69): h + h *_fiber h/N + ... including disconnected hits.
43    // Pass the summing-out fiber C_{o(tau)} for Eq. (70), and the ORIGINAL
44    // physical single-edge transition vector. No stationary input is allowed.
45    // To form Gamma_1, multiply Embed(b), this result, then Embed(sink paths)
46    // in that same fiber. Coefficients are expected peak counts per decay.
47    CAlgebra::Vector SummingInExpansion(const CAlgebra& fiber,
48                                       const DecayVector& transition) const;
49
50    // Positive powers only: h + h^2/N + h^3/N^2 + ... . Input must consist
51    // of single edges. Connected summed paths remain separate basis terms.
52    DecayVector SummingInExpansion(const PathAlgebra& algebra,
53                                  const DecayVector& transition) const;
54private:
55    EfficiencyMap fPeak, fTotal, fConversion;
56    std::size_t fDetectorCount;
57    DecayVector Apply(const DecayVector& vector, int kind, std::size_t avoided = 1) const;
58    CAlgebra::Vector Apply(const CAlgebra::Vector& vector, int kind) const;
59};
60#endif
